No export row with an Indian-origin consignment, foreign destination and B/L number was visible.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split was found in the sources reachable. ImportKey shows only customs counterparties (suppliers/buyers lists: '2580 LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY DIAMOND EVERMINE', '2464 VARNEY DIAM LTD', '824 VARNEY DIAM LIMITED'), which are trade counterparties, not domestic supply evidence.
note: Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey claims 635 shipments for 'VARNI GEMS' but the free view rendered only 1 dated record plus aggregate partner/port tables (5 suppliers, 5 buyers, 7 ports) — i.e. ~1 of 635 rows visible, so the dataset is effectively unverifiable from the free view. The single visible record is an inbound rough-diamond import (HS 71022120, Dubai→Mumbai BKC), which is consistent with the declared HS 710239 (cut/polished diamonds) being a downstream product of the same trade, but it is NOT evidence of export shipments. Slug variants tried: 'varni-gems' (records present, imports only), 'varni-gems-llp' (page exists but zero records rendered: 'Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records'), 'varni-gems-llp/export' (404). Second sources unavailable: volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search returned 'no results (searx: Connection refused)' on both attempts, so no independent corroboration was possible. Note on declared industry: the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) is inconsistent with the declared HS 710239 and with the observed rough-diamond trade — the company appears to be a diamond/gems trader, not FMCG; this is an industry-field correction, not a rejection ground. No export shipments found in reachable sources; no domestic supply traces found either — 'следов поставок не найдено' on the export side, domestic side simply unknown (not public in reachable sources). Revenue and export volume: null (not public in reachable sources; not estimated).
